news.full_en:
Hello, Adventurers!  Welcome to “This Month in Sky”, where we share Sky news, community activities, and creations from Sky Kids around the world.  Get ready to show off your fashion sense this November, we’re welcoming back Days of Style! We also have update 35.5 on the horizon, and more community events such as a group Eden run and Aviary Stage Interviews ready for you! More details below. 
 Please note: All dates and times are listed in PST/PDT.  

 Sky News Update 35.5 November 24th It’s time for our next update! Make sure to check our patch notes page or update video on YouTube when it goes Live for all the details.  
 Days of Mischief  Ends on November 12th Days of Mischief wraps up on Thursday, November 12th, so make sure to say farewell to the tiny witch Brigitta and her friends, and get in as many tricks, treats, and spells as you can during this special event.  
 Days of Style November 27th - December 10th By popular demand, Days of Style is BACK! So put on a fresh fit and take a stroll down the runway where you can show off your unique fashion sense to the waiting audience. You can use emotes to add extra personality to your show, and even record a Shared Memory Duet to create a truly fantastic display of your creative styling. We can’t wait to see what you come up with!
 Traveling Spirits November 5th - 8th November 19th - 22nd A group of Traveling Spirits from Season of Dreams and Season of Performance will visit from November 13th - 26th
 Double Hearts November 13th - 26th, Hearts gifted through the Friendship Menu or Constellation Menu are doubled, along with the Heart fragments received from lighting friends in the Constellation. 
 Community Announcements Days of Mischief Community Goal: Hug the Office Rooftop Krill We knew Sky Kids would get into the Mischief spirit, but you really amazed us with your enthusiasm for krill hugs. Not only did you get tackled by the Office krill over 250,000 times, but you did it faster than we could have imagined! Make sure to check your inbox and claim your reward before Days of Mischief ends on November 12th. Aviary Interview Stage Schedule Join Tethys on the Aviary Stage Tuesdays and Thursdays from 5:30pm - 6:30pm PST. There will be no Interview Stage on Thursday, November 26th, due to the national US holiday, but the Interview Stage will resume on Tuesday, December 1st! Community Eden Run November 20th, 5:00pm PST Join Tethys and other thatgamecompany staff for another community Eden Run!  Festival Tech will be enabled during this event, so it’s the perfect time to head through the Eden gates with friends. 
 Note: thatgamecompany is in a region affected by Daylight Saving Time, which means the Sky schedule changed from PDT to PST on November 1st. Please double check a time conversion website if you’re worried about missing an event!

news.summary_ar: Увлечение медитативной сетевой адвенчурой Sky: Children of the Light привело к необычному социальному феномену среди жителей отдаленных провинций Азии. Игроки из сельских районов Китая начали массово конструировать настоящие летательные аппараты и беспилотники из собранного на ул
news.full_en:
Увлечение медитативной сетевой адвенчурой Sky: Children of the Light привело к необычному социальному феномену среди жителей отдаленных провинций Азии. Игроки из сельских районов Китая начали массово конструировать настоящие летательные аппараты и беспилотники из собранного на улице пластикового мусора, пытаясь перенести виртуальный опыт парения в реальность.

 О необычной активности аудитории сообщила директор по китайскому маркетингу и проектным операциям студии thatgamecompany Юйдан Цэнь в рамках корпоративного подкаста thatTApodcast. По ее словам, провинциальные игроки объединяются в организованные группы, находят бытовые отходы и создают из них действующие самодельные планеры и управляемые дроны без профессионального инженерного оборудования.

 В Китае игроки в Sky из сельской местности пытаются строить собственные самолеты из пластикового мусора. Они собирают отходы и объединяются, чтобы создавать свои летательные аппараты.
- Юйдан Цэнь, директор по маркетингу и проектным операциям thatgamecompany в Китае

 Поводом для публичного обсуждения роликов с кустарными самолетами послужило увлечение технического специалиста thatgamecompany по имени Брайан Ти. Программист потратил 8 месяцев личного времени на самостоятельную сборку полноразмерного летательного аппарата. После демонстрации видеозаписей из китайских деревень инженеры и маркетологи студии провели длительные обсуждения, сравнивая самоделки из отходов с чертежами сотрудника калифорнийского офиса.

 Вместо предостережений о безопасности опасных полетов маркетинговый отдел решил использовать вирусное хобби игроков в рекламных целях. В студии уже начали прорабатывать совместную глобальную инициативу, в рамках которой авторы игры и фанатское сообщество смогут официально объединиться для постройки единого тематического летательного аппарата.

 Мультиплеерная адвенчура Sky: Children of the Light вышла в 2019 году и поддерживается студией уже более 7 лет. На территории Китая проект распространяется через издательство NetEase, где вокруг медитативного исследования виртуальных миров сформировалась обособленная аудитория со специфическими традициями взаимодействия с игровым брендом.

news.full_en:
Greetings, Adventurers! Update 35.0 is launching today on Android, Huawei, iOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Steam!
For a preview of what’s coming to Sky, be sure to check out This Month in Sky and the 35.0 Update Video.  New Features & Improvements Arles Nest In 35.0 we’re introducing the new Arles Nest, located in the Dear Van Gogh area: Arles.  A new portal appears in the Aviary Village Nesting area. Will unlock for players that have a second nest unlocked. The  Arles Nest will be available for unlock to players who have completed Season of Nesting Q2 and Dear Van Gogh Q3. 3 ways to access the nest unlock Entering Arles via the Starry Night’s Mantle teleport Repeating Dear Van Gogh 3rd Quest Joining a friend who is currently in the Arles Nest via the Visit a Friend’s Nest menu 
 Shared Memories: Duets Ever wanted to jump into someone else's Shared Memory? With Shared Memory Duets, you can now record your reaction to an original Shared Memory as a brand-new collaborative Shared Memory. You and the original creators, together in the same moment. Access this new feature by pressing the new Duets button in the Shared Memory viewing menu.  
 Dye cost change The cost required to forge a dye has been decreased. Achievements on GooglePlay Added 23 achievements on GooglePlay.  These are the same achievements that are on other platforms.

 Friendship System Visual adjustments of the UI  Progress preview polish  The Player Friendship menu will show a red dot on recently unlocked level 1 emotes. Presence New animations Players in Presence now have animations for emotes from the following Spirits: Bowing Medalist Nodding Muralist Confetti Cousin Indifferent Alchemist Festival Spin Dancer Troupe Greeter Leaping Dancer Twirling Champion Carnival Athletic Dancer Other improvements The performance of the game while using Presence has significantly improved, especially for low-end devices. Festival Tech also receives these optimizations. Improved Recommendations: Presence will now give you better recommendations for who to play with. Joining a recommended player (golden with a star in the middle of their chest) is still optional. Presence has been expanded to:  Hidden Forest Golden Wasteland Vault of Knowledge. Areas that automatically enable Presence no longer keep it enabled when you exit them. If you have manually enabled Presence, it will stay enabled when going to different areas. Areas where Presence is not allowed still disable it automatically. 
 Bug fixes Items in Bold are representing a fix for something players reported to us.
Please keep reporting bugs, it helps us improve the quality of the game! Art Fixed odd arm placement when offering a white candle. Fixed an issue where players could fall out of the map in the Valley of Triumph. Fixed incorrect arm positioning when holding props while sitting. Fixed the Sleeping Merchant returning to its sleeping animation immediately after being interacted with. Gameplay  Fixed a frequent crash on Switch occurring in Orbit that could leave players stuck in Eden. Fixed an issue where the Introduce Oddball Outcast to a big surprise daily could not be completed if a player had Skip Cutscenes enabled during multiplayer gameplay. Fixed an issue causing inconsistent Daily Quest status information. Fixed an issue where players could become stuck after picking up a Winged Light in Isle of Dawn. Fixed an exploit allowing players to avoid Dark Dragon attacks using mannequin props as bait.  Fixed reflections flickering when the camera moved around on paintings in the Starry Gallery. Fixed an issue causing a brief loss of camera control when a player is progressing spirit quests away from you. Fixed a rare crash related to creating content in Daylight Prairie. Fixed a rare crash that could occur when returning to the Coliseum during the Aurora concert. Localization Fixed an incorrect German translation for the Meditate by the Forest Boneyard Daily Quest. Fixed a text error in a Star Pin dialogue hint. Fixed Creator Awards trophies showing incorrect text when picked up by another player. Outfits & Props Fixed plushies placed underwater floating up into the sky. Fixed the Starry Mantle effect not working correctly during quests 1, 4 and 5. Fixed clipping issues when sitting on the Moonlight Lotus Cushion.  Fixed clipping between the Nature hair and Ocean Wave Veil t cosmetics. Seasons & Spirits \ Fixed brush strokes disappearing when the camera moved away during a quest 4 cutscene. \ Fixed cape cosmetics on some spirits not displaying correctly in sketch during quest 1. Services Fixed an issue preventing players from reporting chat messages from the chat log when using Presence. Fixed an issue where players using Oreo transformation spells would flip upside down when jumping in water. Fixed a visual glitch that appeared during the Artbook video. User Interface Fixed the Closet menu remaining open after leaving the Closet area. Fixed a typo in the date for the ‘Self-Portrait with Grey Felt Hat’ Van Gogh painting. Fixed the New Quest hint appearing throughout Aviary Village instead of when approaching the Season Guide. For Known Issues associated with this update, please see our Known Issues page . As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at discord.gg/thatskygame !

news.full_en:
Hello, Adventurers!  Welcome to “This Month in Sky”, where we share Sky news, community activities, and creations from Sky Kids around the world. It’s been one year since we started This Month in Sky, and we have plenty of fun news to celebrate!  This month, not only are we looking forward to Season of Pearl and Days of Mischief with all of its tricks and treats, but the Community and Events teams worked together to come up with an extra treat this year: a Community Goal activity! Read on for details and other surprises! 

 Please note: All dates and times are listed in PST/PDT. 

 Sky News Update 35.0 October 13th Update 35.0 is on its way! Later this month, keep an eye out for the patch notes and update video to get the full details on new additions and bug fixes.  
 Season of Pearl October 16th - December 31st The final Sky season of 2026 is almost here, and brings with it a new tale to explore! Beginning on October 16th, meet the Old Angler, hear their story, and take part in their adventure on the seas.  
 Days of Mischief October 23rd - November 12th Get ready for tricks, treats, and mischievous fun in the Cackling Crab. There’s a lot to explore – meet the tiny witch Brigitta and other characters who only visit this time of year, play new games like Dark Dragons vs. Crabs, and enjoy returning favorites like the Broom Races. Back by popular demand, the krill have returned to the TGC Office rooftop and are ready to hand out “hugs”, launching Sky Kids into the air! There might even be an extra treat in store; see our Community Announcements section for details on a special Days of Mischief Community Goal activity!

 Radiance Event October 2nd - 15th Black and red Colored Light will appear more often, and there’s increased inventory in the Dye Exchange Shop.  
 Traveling Spirits October 8th - 11th, Welcome back the Traveling Spirit you voted for in the 2026 Sky Creator Awards! October 22nd - 25th 

 Community Announcements Days of Mischief Community Goal: Hug the Office Rooftop Krill October 23rd - November 6th It’s time for Sky’s first in-game Community Goal activity! Beginning with Days of Mischief on October 23rd, if Sky Kids collectively receive 250,000 “hugs” (tackles) from the krill flying above the TGC Office rooftop by November 6th, everyone will receive a special memento in their inbox. Don’t worry, though – these particular mischievous krill may send you flying, but it’s all in the spirit of fun! They won’t try to steal your Winged Light when you visit. Keep an eye out on our social media channels and in-game inbox for more details later this month! 
 Aviary Interview Stage Schedule Join Tethys on the Interview Stage! Please note the schedule change from 4pm to 5:30pm Pacific, starting on October 27th. 
 Note: thatgamecompany is in a region affected by Daylight Saving Time, which means the Sky schedule changes from PDT to PST on November 1st. Please double check a time conversion website if you’re worried about missing an event! 
 October 1st, 4pm PDT (UTC -7) October 6th, 4pm PDT (UTC -7) October 8th, 4pm PDT (UTC -7) October 27th, 5:30pm PDT (UTC -7) October 29th, 5:30pm PDT (UTC -7) November 3rd, 5:30pm PST (UTC -8) November 5th, 5:30pm PST (UTC -8) 
 Community Eden Run October 30th, 5pm PDT (UTC -7) Dress up in your favorite Mischief costume and join Tethys and other TGC staff members, along with a whole host of Sky Kids, during this costumed Community Eden Run! Festival Tech will be enabled during this event, so it’s the perfect time to head through the Eden gates with friends.

news.summary_en:
Greetings, Adventurers! Update 34.5 is launching today on Android, Huawei, iOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Steam!
For a preview of what’s coming to Sky, be sure to check out This Month in Sky! New Features & Improvements Hall of Creativity The Hall of Creativity is officially open!
news.summary_ar:
Greetings, Adventurers! Update 34.5 is launching today on Android, Huawei, iOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Steam!
For a preview of what’s coming to Sky, be sure to check out This Month in Sky! New Features & Improvements Hall of Creativity The Hall of Creativity is officially open!
news.full_en:
Greetings, Adventurers! Update 34.5 is launching today on Android, Huawei, iOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Steam!
For a preview of what’s coming to Sky, be sure to check out This Month in Sky! New Features & Improvements Hall of Creativity The Hall of Creativity is officially open! You'll find it in Aviary Village, head into the Cinema Hall and look to your right, just inside the entrance. While visiting, players can: Hang out with TGC Clementine Watch past Sky Creator Awards on two screens Socialize with other Skykids You may also notice a second room inside. More information about it will be shared in a future update. Challenges Added a new "Trivial" difficulty tier. Challenges that fall into this tier are hidden, so you'll see fewer extremely simple Challenges. Adjusted difficulty scoring so fewer Challenges are classified as "Impossible." Increased the amount of Light rewarded for easy, medium, and hard challenges.  Presence Experimental Feature Chat Across Presence When you and your friends are all actively using Presence in the same level, you can now chat with each other as if you were playing together in the same lobby. Chats from friends who are not using Presence will not be shown to you. New animations Players in Presence now have animations for: Performing a deep call Earning a Candle Purchasing an item Using the Tearful Light Miner and Admiring Actor expressions Improved Embers Embers have been visually revised to look better and to resolve some performance issues. Festival Tech also benefits from this improvement. Other improvements The Presence button in the Wing Menu no longer disappears when the feature is unavailable. Instead, it now explains why you may not be able to attune to Presence. Localization improvements Player-suggested improvements updates for French, German, Portuguese and Japanese. Fixed a number of corrupted text in different languages   Bug fixes Items in Bold are representing a fix for something players reported to us.
Please keep reporting bugs, it helps us improve the quality of the game! Audio Fixed audio crackling and distortion on lower-end Android devices. Gameplay  Fixed an issue where equipped outfits would revert to the default appearance when logging back in. Fixed an issue where Chibi would clip through terrain while in water, preventing them from interacting with dark plants at the temple in the Hidden Forest. Fixed an issue where using a STAR Pin would consume matching spells already in a player's inventory. Fixed an issue where Presence models would blink in and out. Fixed an issue where the drawing would clip fully into the ground for Chibi players when using the Draw emote. Fixed an issue where cancelling out of a transformation spell would leave the Presence button greyed out. Fixed an issue where the player who cancelled a Cradle Carry could no longer end the carry. Jumping while in Little Oreo form no longer has a slight delay. Fixed a crash affecting Android and PC players. Fixed a rendering crash affecting some lower-end Android and iOS devices.
